headline: RBI to hold ₹50,000 crore 4-day VRR auction under LAF on November 23, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct a Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Monday, November 23, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain as per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, along with treasury and finance teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants should bid within the 9:30-10:00 AM window on November 23, 2026, following the January 2022 operational guidelines; others may track liquidity signals.

social.linkedin:
RBI to conduct a 4-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on November 23, 2026.

Key details:
- Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
- Tenor: 4 days
- Window: 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM
- Reversal date: November 27, 2026 (Friday)

The RBI said the auction follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

Why it matters: Such operations are a signal of how the central bank is managing system liquidity, and they can influence short-term money market rates and bank funding costs. Treasury teams and finance professionals may want to keep an eye on the auction outcome.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1538) before acting.
